# Day 39: Course-level check 1, maps

## Teacher page

### Before class
Read teacher-only key-d039.md. Print both sides at actual size. Verify the inset bar is 2 centimeters and R-to-S is 5 centimeters. If resizing occurs, redraw both with a ruler. Prepare a class list with the key's component columns and access/help notes. Reserve at most 45 minutes after class for thirty papers. Keep the packet unseen until today.

### The day
#### 2 min. Opening
Return day 38's assigned s02-P38a, s02-P38b, s02-P38c or s02-P38d privately, with its written cue. Carry unresolved source needs to day 41; do not repair during this check. Explain that the measurement inset is made up. The geographic maps show real places. Review only the independent-work routine, not answers.

#### 10 min. Physical features
Children work alone on [[C1-E39-1]] and [[C1-E39-2]], using Map A's title, index and key. Read neutrally when needed. Observe locating separately from handwriting. The desert patch marks part of the desert, not its boundary.

#### 8 min. Distance
Children answer [[C1-E39-3]] alone using the ruler and inset bar. The inset scale applies only to the invented segment. Do not measure a distance on the geographic outline. Accept working, labels or child-directed dictation.

#### 12 min. Political places
Turn to Side 2. Children answer [[C1-E39-4]] and [[C1-E39-5]] independently. The index locates a place without naming its political category. Each inset has its own extent. Access reading may name printed letters; it must not select or shade an outline.

#### 8 min. Coordinates
Children answer [[C1-E39-6]] on Grid C and check their papers. Collect both sides without showing answers. After class mark each key component shown, shown with help, or not yet seen. Keep access support separate from content help. No totals or rankings. Give one private priority for day 41. If many miss a component, prioritize that route; keep the fresh source leaflet sealed for day 40.

### Other rooms
No screen is needed. No printer: prepare ruled copies of the outlines, keys and grid beforehand. Use the exact measured inset. For pointing access, an adult records the chosen location without interpreting it.

### At home
**Swap.** No printer: copy the packet and measure the inset carefully. No class list: keep the paper in a folder.
**Skip.** Class collection and rankings.
- **2 min. Assessment set-up.** Return day 38 work privately. Read only directions.
- **10 min. Features.** Your child answers [[C1-E39-1]] and [[C1-E39-2]] alone.
- **8 min. Distance.** Supply a ruler for [[C1-E39-3]]. Give no hints.
- **12 min. Places.** Use [[C1-E39-4]] and [[C1-E39-5]]. Read labels neutrally.
- **8 min. Grid.** Your child completes [[C1-E39-6]]. Keep answers private until day 41. Use key-d039.md afterward to choose one next step.

### Shorter or longer
Pause unfinished work and resume within the assessment slot before collection. Retain every component. Longer: children inspect their own labels without answer sharing.

### Words and supports
Review access words from written days: legend and physical feature, days 1 to 3; scale and kilometer, days 5 to 6; province and state, days 9 to 11; latitude and longitude, days 12 to 13. Supply each map's printed key, enlarged type or a scribe. Do not supply definitions of the two terms being assessed.

### Tomorrow
Day 40 checks source judgment on unseen land-and-river evidence. Keep these map results for day 41 Feedback and Response groups. Use the recorded component priorities then. No content repair occurs on day 40.

### Credit
Ours. Original cartography from public-domain geographic records. Source rows C1-geo-country through C1-haiti document real geography. The inset is made up.
